uncertainty: Five pinned open-source package paths passed the valid 2×1 local SVG control and returned rendered red and green pixels: librsvg, libvips, ImageMagick, GraphicsMagick, and resvg. Fifteen more verified paths are needed for the 20-path working goal. Three Homebrew formula-name queries saved 25 hits and 23 unique names (100-result limit per query); the results are fuzzy, not usage ranked, and miss projects outside Homebrew. Five plausible names remain unresolved and are not counted. libvips links librsvg and shares its SVG engine. ImageMagick uses internal MSVG, GraphicsMagick uses SVG-to-MVG, and source-built resvg uses its own usvg parser. The same resvg C API serves C and C++ paths. Primary GitHub stars are available for ImageMagick, libvips, and resvg; canonical librsvg and GraphicsMagick upstreams are not on GitHub and remain unranked. The control covers two rectangles, not broad SVG compliance. No malformed-input, resource-use, or vulnerability experiments were run.
